messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a consolidated list of **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023**.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or is observed on the nearest weekday when it lands on a weekend), giving you at least three consecutive days off (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).

| Date(s) | Holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 2** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Jan 1 2023 was a Sunday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Mar 20** | Family Day (Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan) | March 20 2023 was a Monday. (Other provinces have different dates or no Family Day.) |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday (statutory holiday in all provinces except Quebec) | Good Friday is a Friday; the weekend gives you a 3‑day break. |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day (observed May 22) | Victoria Day is always the Monday preceding May 25; it creates a long weekend. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | July 1 2023 fell on a Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day (observed Sep 4) | Labour Day is the first Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Thanksgiving is the second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Nov 11 2023 was a Saturday; the holiday is observed on Monday Nov 13. |
| **Dec 24 – Dec 25** | Christmas (observed Dec 25) | Dec 25 2023 was a Monday; the weekend gives you a 3‑day break (Dec 24 Sunday + Dec 25 Monday). |

### Quick Reference

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) – observed Jan 2 | Jan 1‑2 |
| Family Day | Mar 20 (Mon) | Mar 20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7‑9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20‑22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Jul 3 | Jul 1‑3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2‑4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7‑9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) – observed Nov 13 | Nov 11‑13 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 24‑25 |

> **Provinces with additional long weekends**  
> - **Family Day**: Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan (March 20).  
> - **St. Patrick’s Day**: Not a statutory holiday in any province.  
> - **Other provincial holidays** (e.g., St. George’s Day, St. Andrew’s Day) do not create long weekends in 2023.

Feel free to plug this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need province‑specific details or want to include other statutory holidays that don’t create long weekends, let me know!
